title.en: Hyperscaler Capital Expenditures, Operating Cash Flow, and Capex Intensity (Figure 1)
title.zh: 超大规模云厂商资本开支、经营现金流与资本开支强度（图 1）

description.en: Annual aggregate capital expenditures (capex) and operating cash flow (OCF), in billions of dollars, for Oracle, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, and Alphabet, 2020-2026, as plotted in Figure 1. The figure also plots a Capex/OCF ratio line against the right axis, but no per-year ratio values are stated in the text.
description.zh: Oracle、Microsoft、Amazon、Meta、Alphabet 五家超大规模云厂商 2020–2026 年合计资本开支（capex）与经营现金流（OCF），单位十亿美元，来自图 1。图 1 右轴另绘有 Capex/OCF 比率线，但正文与文本抽取均未给出逐年比率数值。

sections: Section III. Ownership and Financing of AI Infrastructure

label.en: Aggregate capex (Oracle, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, Alphabet)

label.zh: 五家公司合计经营现金流

notes: Narrative (PDF p.8): aggregate capex 'rose from roughly $97 billion in 2020 to more than $400 billion in 2025 and are projected to exceed $800 billion in 2026'; 'On current estimates, capex will surpass the five firms’ combined operating cash flow for the first time in 2026' — i.e., 2026 is the first year capex exceeds combined OCF.

LIMITATION — per-company values not available: the Figure 1 legend assigns a color to each company (Oracle, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, Alphabet), but the text gives only the aggregate series; the paper does not report per-company capex or OCF values for Figure 1.

The figure also plots 'capital intensity, measured as the ratio of aggregate capital expenditures to aggregate operating cash flow' (Capex/OCF) on the right axis, whose tick labels run 30%-120%; per-year ratio values are not stated in the text and are therefore not extracted.

Figure 1 notes (PDF p.9): 'Historical values are constructed from company 10-K and 10-Q SEC filings and measure cash capital expenditures and GAAP operating cash flow. Microsoft and Oracle are converted from fiscal-year to calendar-year values using quarterly and year-to-date filings.'

Figure 1 notes (PDF p.9): 'The 2026 values combine reported results with the latest company guidance and Wall Street estimates. Hyperscaler capex includes non-AI related capex but excludes capex for data centers leased by the hyperscalers.'

Context (PDF p.8): historically hyperscalers financed data center investment 'through retained earnings and unsecured corporate debt', owned facilities directly, and bore 'construction, utilization, and residual-value risk'; the marginal financing model is shifting toward third-party capital.
Column keys renamed from raw (capex_usd_b→capex_bn, ocf_usd_b→ocf_bn); values verbatim.
